Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You cite market increases, yet your earlier letter says your alloy requirements are covered at fixed prices—it seems market movements and your actual cost exposure need to be separated. We want to build on the partnership with a price grounded in the costs you actually incur. Following your owner's offer to review the calculation, how can you substantiate the quoted price with a cost-breakdown XLSX separating material, labour and processing and showing the effect of that coverage?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Using your own cost shares (AS-14404 45%, LCI-C 5%, PPI-C2431 38%) and the latest six-month index moves (AS-14404 -0.3% (idx:AS-14404@2026-03, idx:AS-14404@2026-09), LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2431 +9.7%), your cost increase comes to about +3.6% of the price, not +11.0%. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.73 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.70 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate the proposed 24-month volume and 14-day payment terms, which we have incorporated to offer a more favorable price.
As our alloy requirements are currently covered at fixed prices, recent index decreases do not affect our purchasing expenses; additionally, a 24-month agreement necessitates an AS-14404 index clause.
While we are unable to provide a detailed internal cost breakdown, we propose €5.49 per unit based on your accelerated payment terms and the required indexation.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.49 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

You credit faster payment with a more favorable price, yet your standard-payment offer is lower; it seems the financing benefit has not been consistently reflected. We want a defensible base price and alloy-risk protection that applies when market movements actually reach your costs. How can you reconcile the pricing and translate the financing benefit into a lower base price?

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.80 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 5% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.84 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 5% deadband), 45 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH team,

We acknowledge your final offer and the lower unit price linked to the longer payment term. Please reconsider sharing the cost breakdown in XLSX format to substantiate the pricing elements, and confirm a modest further unit-price reduction so we can conclude the discussion. Any index clause should take effect only after your fixed-price alloy cover ends.

We confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +3.6%.

We accept your alternative as you proposed it; it is attached as a term sheet for your confirmation.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
